_traits._about: Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored by the loader. 'traits' tell the shared processor/report code how an API behaves; add the matching ones when adding an API instead of editing api-name lists in code.
_traits.image_output: Generates images (Generated_Output), text_to_image and random-source/reference cross-match modes; image-gen testbed override.
_traits.endframe_pairs: Source images come as _a/_b start/end pairs; only A images seed report rows.
_traits.kling_model_name: Report display name is refined from the configured Kling model version.
_traits.model_per_task: Model may be set on the first task rather than at config root (display-name lookup).
_traits.video_combination: Source images × source videos cross-combination layout (tiered failure ordering, grouped by video).
_traits.base_folder_layout: Report collects rows via process_base_folder_structure (base_folder or task folders).
_traits.text_to_video: Prompt-only generation; report built by process_text_to_video_batch.
_traits.ttv_output_folder: TTV outputs live under the config's output_folder/Generated_Video (not per-task folders).
_traits.multi_source_images: A row may carry extra source images shown alongside the main source.
_traits.video_media: Source/generated media slots in the report are always video.
_traits.task_folders: Each task has its own folder (with Source/) under a dated group folder that supplies the report date.
_traits.effect_folders: base_folder/<effect>/ subfolders per effect (Vidu effects / I2V).
_traits.reference_folder: Per-effect Reference/ folder of extra images paired with each source.
_traits.base_folder_name: Report title/filename uses the config's base_folder name.

api_params.img_prompt: Generate a portrait-oriented image of a realistic, clear plastic gashapon capsule being held between two fingers as depicted in the provided image. Inside the capsule is a Chibi-style, full-figure miniature version of the person in the uploaded photo. The focus should be on the hand holding the capsule and the clear plastic material.
